project.project_description: Turnkey design, engineering, procurement, installation, interconnection, and commissioning of a rooftop solar PV system, with an additive alternate for an integrated battery energy storage system.
project.location: Town Recycling Center, 34 N. Menantic Road, Shelter Island, NY 11964, USA

package_subscope: Base rooftop grid-connected solar PV system at the Recycling Center plus an additive alternate integrated BESS.

initial_state.boundary: Buyer-authored requirements and solicitation metadata only; excludes supplier proposals, offered prices, negotiations, awards, and later outcomes.

technical_specifications.summary: Grid-connected rooftop PV system on an approximately 120 ft by 55 ft low-pitch metal roof, interconnected to an existing 480 V three-phase service.

line_items.description: Integrated battery energy storage system additive alternate

technical_specifications.summary: Battery energy storage capability requested as an explicitly defined additive alternate integrated with the facility electrical infrastructure.
